user.title: Measurements
user.description: The building model learns from the hourly statistics of these sensors in the recorder. With existing history it is ready right away.

data_description.room_sensors: Indoor temperature sensors of the rooms on this circuit, all preselected. Remove rooms that are not heated by it. The controller uses their mean.
data_description.supply_sensor: The actual flow temperature of the floor heating circuit, after the mixing valve.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: A reliable outdoor temperature, ideally a mean or median of several sensors.
data_description.weather_entity: Needs an hourly forecast. Without it the current outdoor temperature is held.
data_description.price_sensor: A sensor with hourly prices in its attributes, e.g. from the [EPEX Spot integration](https://github.com/mampfes/ha_epex_spot). Nord Pool and Tibber formats work as well.

data.control_mode: How should the set point reach your heating?

data_description.control_mode: With a set point sensor, the integration creates the sensor "Supply set point output". Your heating controller reads it (e.g. ESPHome homeassistant sensor). It only carries a value while control is active; otherwise it is unavailable and the controller keeps its own heating curve.

target_climate.title: Climate entity
target_climate.description: The climate entity whose target temperature is the supply set point.

target_number.title: Number entity
target_number.description: The number or input_number that takes the supply set point. It is written every hour.

error.rooms_required: Choose at least one room sensor.

data_description.enable_entity: Not needed to switch control on: the integration has its own switch "Control active". Use this only to pause automatically, e.g. with the operating mode of the heating (off/cool pause, heat runs).
data_description.horizon: Hours the controller looks ahead. Should be well above the reaction time of the floor.
data_description.train_days: Days of recorder statistics used to learn the model. Retrained every night.
